### The University of Jordan

---

#### Course Offerings

| Course Number | Course Title                                    | Credit Hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0431123       | The Prophet's Biography                         | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:** |                                        |              |
| **Course Description:** | This course includes an introduction to the study of the Prophet's biography: the sources and characteristics of the Prophet's biography. The events and episodes of the Prophet's biography from birth to death. | |

| Course Number | Course Title                                    | Credit Hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0431132       | The Foundations of Islamic Theology             | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:** |                                        |              |
| **Course Description:** | This course aims to give the students a general introduction to the foundations and pillars of Islamic Faith. It covers the following topics: the concept of the creed, its characteristics and fundamentals; the meaning of faith, its ranks, essence, and monotheism, a brief study of fate, faith evidence, limits, and aspects. Then the Qur'anic manner in presenting creed matters. | |

| Course Number | Course Title                                    | Credit Hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0401202       | The Biography Of The Rightly-Guided Caliphs    | 3            |
| **Prerequisites:** |                                        |              |
| **Course Description:** | This course highlights the most important events and developments in political administration and military both domestic and foreign affairs of the Islamic state. It addresses the issue of how we can benefit from these events in our contemporary time by analyzing the methodology of every caliph in implementing Islam. | |

| Course Number | Course Title                                    | Credit Hours |
|---------------|------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 0401203       | Methodologies of Research in The Sciences of Foundations of Religion | 3 |
| **Prerequisites:** |                                        |              |
| **Course Description:** | The course highlights the principles of academic research and the characteristics of successful research in terms of the principles of choosing the material, steps of research, rules of referencing. It concentrates basically on recourses of the fundamentals of Islam i.e. Qur'anic exegesis (interpretation), prophetic sayings, and faith. | |
